messages:
Tess: heads-up: I'm about to kick off a preview run for `flags.pool_leasing.window_ms` on staging in ~20m. goal is to validate behavior w/o switching live leasing logic.
Ibrahim: good. confirm preview-only (no enforcement)? we need to ensure no active lease churn affects customers.
Tess: yes preview-only. runtime will evaluate new window and emit a preview snapshot for diffs.
Clara: API note: preview currently behaves sync and returns 200. can we change preview apply to return 202 + preview_id + estimated_propagation_ms? avoids accidental sync assumptions by SDKs.
Jon: agree. preview should be async by default. keep an escape hatch param `?force_sync=true` for emergency fixes.
Ibrahim: telemetry: avoid per-tenant metric labels. emit cohort-level aggregates `leasing.preview_delta{cohort="cX"}` plus a sampled secure event stream `leasing.preview_samples` (default 1/500) that includes salted tenant_hash and cohort.
Clara: console UX: show a compact diff panel with current vs preview aggregates (p50/p95 lease_latency, granted_rate, orphan_count). include a clickable "Inspect samples" list that opens redacted events. ops asked for that after last rollout.
Tess: implementation plan: 1) preview apply -> returns 202 + preview_id 2) preview status endpoint `/preview/{id}` returns {state, estimated_propagation_ms, affected_shards} 3) persist preview snapshot + sampled events to S3 for 30d.
Ibrahim: metric cardinality: emit per-shard boolean `leasing.preview_anomaly{shard="sh-7"}` when invariant breaks, and emit sampled tenant events to secure logs at 1/500. that keeps metrics sane and still gives tenant-level evidence.
Jon: runbook: auto-pause preview if any cohort sees >3% absolute increase in `orphan_count` OR if `leasing.preview_anomaly` fires twice in 10m. ops-bot should create an incident draft and attach the preview snapshot.
Clara: ACK modal: include preview_id, commit sha, who initiated preview, human-friendly bullet diff, and a checkbox that the approver has read the runbook. returning an `audit_token` after ACK that must be presented for any rollback action.
Ibrahim: replay job: create a deterministic replay that replays sampled inputs under both current and preview logic and emits a CSV summary (cpu_ms, tokens, lease_ops_delta). Optimize can consume that. queue replay to run after preview completes or at scheduled time to avoid load windows.
Tess: approved telemetry names: `leasing.preview_delta`, `leasing.preview_anomaly`, `leasing.preview_samples`. sampling rate is runtime-configurable and exposed in Dedicated/Private builds. I'll add SR defaults in the PR.
Jon: security: ensure sampled tenant hashes are salted and one-way hashed before leaving runtime; also restrict sampled event access to secops + owners.
Clara: UI request: when preview is active show a timeline widget (start, auto-pause events, manual ACKs) and an "export evidence" button that zips snapshot + sampled traces + replay CSV and attaches to incident drafts.
Ibrahim: API contract note: preview status should also return `preview_size_estimate` (# affected keys) so Console can show an impact estimate. include `affected_shards` too.
Tess: thanks. I'll open two small PRs: 1) preview API semantics + status 2) telemetry + sampling + persistence. will link runbook and sample metric names.
prod-bot: preview-created by tess/pool-window-preview  diff: 5 files changed  http://ci.redwood/internal/9901
Jon: please tag me on the API PR to review the status schema. also include examples for SDK behavior when receiving 202.
Clara: and tag infra for alerts wiring (per-shard gauge + incident automation).
Tess: will do. launching preview in 20. ping if you want early access to sampled events.
Ibrahim: thanks all. this async preview + audit_token flow should reduce accidental sync rollouts.
